notes: Blind answer matches key: a = (20 - 0) / 5 = 4 m/s^2. Distractors reflect plausible errors (t/v, v - t, v*t). Explanation correct. No pages or objective in packet, so support is not_checked. Difficulty 2 fits a one-step application. Arabic is correct and uses standard curriculum terms (السكون، تسارع ثابت).

Blind answer matches key: perpendicular legs, so |d| = sqrt(30^2 + 40^2) = 50 m. Distractors cover difference (10), average (35) and distance travelled (70), which targets the distance/displacement confusion. Explanation correct. Stem asks for magnitude only, so no direction is needed. No pages or objective, so support is not_checked. Arabic correct (الإزاحة، المسافة المقطوعة).

Blind answer matches key: d = 1/2 g t^2 = 4.9 x 9 = 44.1 m. Distractors: 14.7 (t not squared), 29.4 (v = gt), 88.2 (missing 1/2). Explanation correct and names two of them. High-risk only because of Stage 1 L003 warn. The stem does end with ؟ followed by a parenthetical givens block (اعتبر g = 9.8 ... وأهمل مقاومة الهواء), which is standard Arabic textbook style, so L003 is a false positive here and not a content defect. No pages or objective, so support is not_checked.

Blind answer matches key: d = v0^2 / (2a) = 400 / 8 = 50 m (equivalently t = 5 s, d = average speed 10 x 5 = 50 m). Explanation is correct: it treats a as the magnitude of the deceleration, so the minus sign in v^2 = v0^2 - 2ad is consistent. Distractors 100 (missing 2), 80 (v0 x a) and 200 (v0^2 / 2) are plausible. No pages or objective, so support is not_checked. Arabic correct (تباطأت بمعدل ثابت، المكابح).

Blind answer matches key: t = sqrt(2 x 78.4 / 9.8) = 4 s, x = 15 x 4 = 60 m. Explanation correct and states why horizontal velocity is constant. Distractors 120 (t^2 = h/g = 8 used as t) and 240 (t^2 = 16 used as t) reflect real errors. High-risk because difficulty 4 and the Stage 1 L003 warn. L003 is a false positive: the stem ends with ؟ followed by a parenthetical givens block. Difficulty: a two-step projectile with clean numbers; I estimate 3, but 4 is defensible for Tahsili. No pages or objective, so support is not_checked.

issues.suggestion: The stem asks for direct recall of the SI unit of force; relabel item_style as definition.
Recalling a basic SI unit with clearly distinct distractors (J, W, Pa) fits difficulty 1.

notes: Blind answer matches key: النيوتن (N). One defensible answer. The explanation is correct: 1 N = 1 kg·m/s², J is the unit of work and energy, W of power, Pa of pressure. Arabic terms match Saudi textbooks (النظام الدولي للوحدات، الشغل، القدرة، الضغط). No pages or objective, so support is not_checked.

Blind answer matches key: net force 12 N east, a = 12 / 4 = 3 m/s^2 east. The frictionless surface (أملس) makes the net force unambiguous. Distractors target sign/direction error (3 west), ignoring the opposing force (5) and adding the forces (7). Explanation is correct and names Newton's second law. No pages or objective, so support is not_checked. Arabic correct (القوة المحصلة، سطح أفقي أملس).

Blind answer matches key: the reaction to Earth's pull on the book is the book's pull on Earth. There is one defensible answer. The normal force balances the weight on the same body and is not a reaction pair. The book pressing on the table is the reaction to the normal force. There is no friction because no horizontal force acts. The explanation covers all three distractors correctly, including same kind of force and different bodies. Difficulty 3 fits a classic misconception item. item_style application is defensible (conceptual would also fit). No pages or objective, so support is not_checked. Arabic correct (ردّ الفعل، القوة العمودية).

Blind answer matches key. Constant velocity => net force zero => F = μmg = 0.4×5×9.8 = 19.6 N. Distractors are principled (2 N omits g, 49 N is the weight, 122.5 N is mg/μ). Explanation correct. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn is benign: the question ends with ؟ followed only by the givens parenthetical (اعتبر g = 9.8 m/s²). One-step application; difficulty 2–3 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. a = 30/(4+2) = 5 m/s²; contact force on the 2 kg box = 2×5 = 10 N. Explanation correct, including that 20 N is the net force on the first box (30 − 10 = 4×5) and 30 N the full applied force. Frictionless surface stated, so a single defensible answer. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Classic two-step contact-force problem; difficulty 3 seems closer than 4, but within tolerance.

issues.span: و6 J عن عدم تربيع السرعة
issues.suggestion: Not squaring v gives ½×2×3 = 3 J, not 6 J; 6 J = m×v (dropping both ½ and the square, i.e. the momentum value). Rewrite as: «و3 J تنتج عن عدم تربيع السرعة، و6 J عن ضرب الكتلة في السرعة (mv) دون ½ ودون تربيع».

notes: Blind answer matches key. KE = ½mv² = ½×2×3² = 9 J; the key is correct and unambiguous. The explanation misattributes the 6 J distractor: not squaring the speed gives 3 J, while 6 J is mv. The 18 J attribution (dropping ½) is correct. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Difficulty 2 fits a single-formula substitution.

Blind answer matches key (display index 3 = 100 J). W = Fd cos θ = 50×4×0.5 = 100 J. Explanation correct: sin instead of cos gives 100√3 J, ignoring the angle gives 200 J. Angle is stated relative to the direction of motion, so no ambiguity. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Single-formula application; difficulty 2–3 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. Constant speed => crane force = mg; W = mgh = 100×9.8×6 = 5880 J; P = 5880/20 = 294 W. Explanation correct. Distractors are principled (30 W omits g, 49 W omits h, 5880 W is work not divided by time). Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn is benign: the question ends with ؟ followed only by the givens parenthetical. Two-step substitution; difficulty 2–3 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. PE = mgh = 3×9.8×5 = 147 J. Explanation correct and all distractor attributions check out (15 J omits g, 73.5 J is a spurious ½, 29.4 N is the weight). Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn is benign: the question ends with ؟ followed only by the givens parenthetical. Single direct substitution; difficulty 1–2 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. mgh = μmg·d => d = h/μ = 10/0.5 = 20 m. Explanation correct and rightly notes m and g cancel; the given g is a harmless red herring. Distractors 5 m (h·μ), 10 m (h) and 40 m (2h/μ) are plausible slips. Smooth curve and rough horizontal surface are stated, so one defensible answer. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn is benign (؟ precedes the givens parenthetical). Energy-plus-friction reasoning; difficulty 3–4 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. Ohm's law I = V/R = 12/4 = 3 A. Explanation correct though minimal (it could name the distractor slips: 8 A = V−R, 16 A = V+R, 48 A = V×R). Ideal source assumed, as is standard at this level. Internal item with no pages, so support not_checked. Single direct substitution; difficulty 1–2 acceptable.

Blind answer matches key. Req = 12 ohm, I = 2 A, V(6 ohm) = 12 V. Distractors map to the 2 ohm drop (4 V), the 4 ohm drop (8 V) and the source voltage (24 V). Explanation correct; Arabic terminology (المقاومة المكافئة، فرق الجهد، التوالي) matches the Saudi curriculum. No pages cited, so support not checked. Two-step routine calculation; 2-3 is reasonable.

Blind answer matches key: 1/R = 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2, R = 2 ohm. Explanation correct, including the distractor rationale (0.5 = forgetting to invert, 9 = series sum; 4.5 is the arithmetic mean). Terminology (المقاومة المكافئة، التوازي) is standard. No pages cited, so support not checked. Single-formula product-over-sum item; 2 fits better than 3 but within tolerance.

Blind answer matches key: E = P x t = 2 kW x 3 h = 6 kWh. Distractors are plausible errors (2/3, 3/2, no W to kW conversion). Explanation correct. Arabic wording and units (القدرة، الطاقة الكهربائية، kWh) fine. No pages cited, so support not checked. One unit conversion plus one multiplication; 2 is a closer estimate than 3.

Blind answer matches key: F' = k(2q1)(2q2)/(r/2)^2 = 4 x 4 x F = 16F. Distractors cover partial reasoning (4F from only one change, 8F from halving r treated linearly, F from assuming the changes cancel). Explanation correct and consistent with Coulomb's law. Arabic terminology (قانون كولوم، شحنتان نقطيتان) is standard. No pages, so support not checked. High-risk only by difficulty 4; two-factor proportional reasoning is a standard Tahsili item, so 3 fits, though 4 is defensible.

Blind answer matches key: v = f x lambda = 50 x 4 = 200 m/s. Distractors reflect dividing (lambda/f = 0.08, f/lambda = 12.5) and adding (54). Explanation correct. Arabic terminology (التردد، الطول الموجي، سرعة الانتشار) is standard. No pages, so support not checked. Direct one-step substitution; 1-2 is appropriate, which is consistent with the tagged 2.

Blind answer matches key: sound is a mechanical wave that needs a material medium. The distractors are clearly false (temperature, frequency drop, EM wave), and option lengths give no cue. Explanation correct (longitudinal compressions/rarefactions; light as an EM wave crosses vacuum). Arabic terminology (موجة ميكانيكية، وسط مادي، تضاغطات وتخلخلات) matches the Saudi curriculum. No pages, so support not checked. This is closer to conceptual recall than application, and 1-2 is appropriate.

Blind answer matches key: the echo time is a round trip, so d = 340 x 2 / 2 = 340 m. 680 m is the classic trap (forgetting to halve); 170 and 1360 are halving or doubling errors. Explanation correct. Arabic wording (صدى، سرعة الصوت) is natural. No pages, so support not checked. Standard echo item with one conceptual trap; 2-3 is fine.

Blind answer matches key: f3 = 3v/2L = 3 x 48 / 2.4 = 60 Hz (lambda = 0.8 m). Distractors are the 1st harmonic (20 Hz), the 2nd harmonic (40 Hz) and 120 Hz (using lambda/2 as the wavelength). The parenthetical 'third harmonic' is consistent with three antinodes for a string fixed at both ends. Explanation correct. Terminology (موجة موقوفة، بطون، عقد، التوافقية) matches the Saudi physics textbooks. No pages, so support not checked. Difficulty 3 is appropriate.

Blind answer matches key: f = 576 x 340 / (340 - 20) = 612 Hz. Distractors are principled (544 = receding source, 576 = no shift, 596 = additive error). Explanation correct. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Single-formula substitution with clean numbers reads closer to difficulty 3 than 4.

issues.suggestion: The stem asks to recall a constant (speed of light); nothing is applied. Label it recall/knowledge rather than application.

notes: Blind answer matches key (3 x 10^8 m/s). Explanation correct: 3 x 10^5 m/s is the km/s-vs-m/s confusion, 340 and 1500 m/s are approximate sound speeds in air and water. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Pure recall of a constant; difficulty 1-2.

Blind answer matches key: angles are measured from the normal, so incidence = 90 - 30 = 60 degrees and reflection = 60 degrees. The 30-degree distractor targets the classic surface-vs-normal error; 120 degrees is the angle between the rays, as the explanation states. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked.

Blind answer matches key: 1/di = 1/10 - 1/30 = 2/30, di = 15 cm. Distractors map to real errors (7.5 = adding reciprocals, 20 = 30 - 10, 40 = 30 + 10). Explanation correct, including real inverted image (object beyond 2F gives image between F and 2F). No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked.

issues.span: ما زاوية الانكسار؟ (اعتبر معامل انكسار الهواء 1)
issues.suggestion: Move the givens note before the question so the stem ends with ؟, e.g. '... معامل انكساره √2، ومعامل انكسار الهواء 1. ما زاوية الانكسار؟'

notes: Blind answer matches key: sin 45 = √2 sin r gives sin r = 1/2, r = 30 degrees. Explanation correct, and the bending-toward-normal remark is consistent. Only issue is the Stage 1 L003 warn (stem ends with a parenthetical after ؟), which is cosmetic. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked.

Blind answer matches key: 1/di = 1/12 - 1/6 = -1/12, di = -12 cm (virtual, upright), m = 12/6 = 2. Explanation correct and consistent with the magnifier case (object inside focal length). The 2x2 option grid (nature x magnification) is clean with one defensible answer. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Two steps plus sign interpretation: difficulty 3-4.

Blind answer matches key: 27 + 273 = 300 K. Stem does not say 'approximately', but the exact 300.15 K is not offered and the explanation notes the 273.15 value, so only one option is defensible. Distractors map to stated errors. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Optional: Saudi physics texts usually say 'سلسيوس' rather than 'السيليزية'. One-step conversion, difficulty 1-2.

issues.suggestion: Put the specific-heat given before the question so the stem ends with ؟, e.g. 'إذا كانت الحرارة النوعية للماء 4200 J/(kg·°C)، فما كمية الحرارة اللازمة ... إلى 40 °C؟'

notes: Blind answer matches key: Q = 2 x 4200 x 15 = 126000 J. All three distractors verified against the stated errors (336000 uses 40 instead of ΔT, 63000 drops the mass, 8400 drops ΔT). Explanation correct. Only issue is the Stage 1 L003 warn (stem ends with a parenthetical after ؟), which is cosmetic. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked.

issues.span: ما درجة الحرارة النهائية للخليط؟ (أهمل الحرارة التي يكتسبها الوعاء)
issues.suggestion: Move the parenthetical before the question so the stem ends with ؟: «... في وعاء معزول حراريًا (أهمل الحرارة التي يكتسبها الوعاء). ما درجة الحرارة النهائية للخليط؟»

notes: Blind answer matches key: T = (1x80 + 3x20)/4 = 35 °C. Distractors principled (50 = simple average ignoring masses, 65 = masses swapped, 100 = sum). Explanation correct and consistent. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn is caused only by the trailing parenthetical after ؟; content is otherwise clean.

Blind answer matches key: heat absorbed (+500 J) and work done on the gas (+200 J) both raise U, so dU = 700 J. Explanation uses the dU = Q - W (work by gas) convention consistently and reaches 700 J. Distractors principled (300 = sign error, 500 = ignores work, 200 = ignores heat). No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. The sign-convention trap justifies difficulty 3. Arabic wording fine.

issues.span: إلى ماء عند 20 °C؟ (الحرارة الكامنة لانصهار الجليد 3.36 × 10⁵ J/kg، والحرارة النوعية للماء 4200 J/(kg·°C))
issues.suggestion: Put the constants on their own line as a givens block after the question (or before it) so the stem does not end with a parenthesis after ؟.
Two standard substitutions (mL + mcΔT) with round numbers; difficulty 3 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key: Q = 0.5x3.36e5 + 0.5x4200x20 = 1.68e5 + 0.42e5 = 2.1e5 J. Distractors principled (1.68e5 = melting only, 4.2e4 = heating only, 3.78e5 = heating to 100 °C). Explanation correct and consistent. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Stage 1 L003 warn comes only from the trailing parenthetical constants.

Blind answer matches key: E = hf, and X-rays have the highest frequency of the four options. Only one option is above visible light, so no ambiguity. Explanation correct and consistent. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Item is closer to conceptual than application (applying E = hf to spectrum order), acceptable. Arabic terms (الأشعة السينية، الأشعة تحت الحمراء، موجات الراديو) match curriculum usage.

issues.suggestion: Saudi physics textbooks use دالة الشغل; make it the main term in the stem, explanation and tag (drop or demote اقتران الشغل, which is Jordanian usage).
One subtraction KEmax = hf - W with whole-number eV values; difficulty 2 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key: KEmax = 5 - 2 = 3 eV. Distractors principled (7 = added, 2.5 = divided, 10 = multiplied). Explanation correct and consistent with Einstein's photoelectric equation. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked.

Blind answer matches key: 15/5 = 3 half-lives, 80 -> 40 -> 20 -> 10 g. Distractors principled (40 = one half-life, 20 = two, 26.7 = linear division by 3). Explanation correct and consistent. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Three halvings with whole numbers read closer to difficulty 2 than 3. Arabic (نظير مشع، عمر النصف) fine.

Blind answer matches key: alpha emission lowers A by 4 and Z by 2, so 238/92 -> 234/90 (thorium-234, correctly named in the explanation). Distractors principled (238/90 = mass unchanged, 236/90 = mass minus 2, 234/94 = Z raised). No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. A single standard alpha-decay rule reads closer to difficulty 2 than 3. Arabic terms (العدد الكتلي، العدد الذري، جسيم ألفا) fine.

Blind answer matches key: E4 = -0.85 eV, E2 = -3.4 eV, photon energy = 3.4 - 0.85 = 2.55 eV. Distractors principled (4.25 = sum, 3.4 = |E2| only, 0.85 = |E4| only). Explanation correct and consistent; the formula is given in the stem, so the item is self-contained. No pages cited (internal_authored), so support not_checked. Two substitutions and a difference with the formula supplied read closer to difficulty 3 than 4.
